channel.title: Say It Right: Two-Minute Repair for Couples
channel.description:
Short, practical episodes for the moments after an argument: how to ask for a break without walking out, how to apologize without excuses, and what to say when you feel misunderstood. About two minutes each. Not a substitute for counselling or for help if you feel unsafe.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of UnFight: Couples & Marriage, a private iPhone app to pause an argument, find clearer words and decide what to do next. UnFight: Couples & Marriage on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
